verdict.rationale: AI controls are a fair question for a terminal emulator, since competitors in this category ship AI features, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no AI features in Ghostty, no controls for enabling or disabling them, and no statement about what session data leaves the machine. Docs saying it needs zero configuration to run do not establish data-egress controls or a no-login policy, so nothing in the pack delivers this story.
